content:
maria: FYI I'm hitting a weird ESM/CJS interop bug when using the JS SDK in our sampleapp deployed to Vercel Edge. Works locally in Node, fails during edge build with type errors and runtime: "Cannot read property 'default' of undefined" after a dynamic conditional import.

aj: can you paste minimal repro + error?

maria: repro steps quick:
1) create sampleapp using our edge runtime sample
2) conditionally import an auth adapter based on env (server vs edge)
3) build with vite (ssr) and deploy to edge
Error snippet during runtime:
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'default' of undefined
    at handleAuth (./src/auth.ts:12:24)
    at runtime (edge-runtime)
```
Code that's failing (simplified):
```ts
// src/auth.ts
export async function getAdapter() {
  if (process.env.USE_LEGACY) {
    return (await import('./adapters/legacy')).default
  } else {
    return (await import('./adapters/modern')).adapter
  }
}
```
Both adapters are canonical ESM/TS modules with `export default` and `export const adapter` respectively. Locally in Node (esm) `await import()` returns correct shapes. Vite/Rollup builds end up emitting a wrapper that returns `{ default: { adapter: ... } }` or sometimes the other way around depending on plugin ordering.

liam: this smells like bundler conditional dynamic import + interop quirks. Vite's ssr build sometimes adds `interopDefaultLegacy` wrappers. For rollup/webpack you can hit double-wrapping.

sam: did you try `const m = await import(...); return m?.default ?? m;` as a workaround? Also check `esModuleInterop`/`allowSyntheticDefaultImports`/`module` in tsconfig — they change emitted shapes.

maria: tried that, helped in some cases but still flaky when the adapter exports a named `adapter` (the modern one). The shape becomes `{ default: { adapter: [Function] } }` so `m?.default?.adapter` works, but sometimes it's `{ adapter: [Function] }` (no default). We need robust pattern.

aj: for SDK parity we should export both a default and named export from our adapters so consumers don't have to detect. i.e. in adapters export `export default adapter; export { adapter };` That buys compatibility across bundlers.

liam: agree, also add a tiny helper util `normalizeImport()` in the SDK that does `return m && (m.default ?? m)` and type it as `T` in TS so typings align. We should include it in the runtime edge bundle though (keep small).

ci-bot: deploy failed for branch fix/dx-bundler-dynamic-import — build log attached: 
```
Error: Module build failed: Unexpected token 'export' in CJS context
at runBuild (build.js:45)
```

sam: that's the other axis — some bundlers transform ESM to CJS and then toolchain treats dynamic import differently. For vite SSR you can force `ssr: { external: [...] }` or `optimizeDeps` settings, but that's painful for customers.

maria: goals: 1) add normalizeImport helper + TS types in SDK, 2) export default+named in our example adapters, 3) update sampleapp docs with a short note on conditional imports + bundlers and a recommended snippet. Also add a tiny repro repo in samples so folks can reproduce with vite/rollup/webpack.

aj: I'll open a PR for helper + adapter export changes. Can you add repro branch in samples? I'll link PR to it.

maria: will create sampleapp branch `samples/dynamic-import-repro` and include minimal vite + rollup configs and instructions. I'll also include `tsconfig.json` variations (module: "esnext" vs "commonjs") so we can test.

liam: we should also add a unit test that bundles the SDK with esbuild/vite/rollup snapshots to catch regressions. Might be overkill but useful.

maria: cool. I'll post link when the branch is up. thanks :thumbsup:

aj: thx — if anyone has quick patches for sample app today ping me and I'll help debug.

devx-bot: created issue #542: "dynamic conditional import bundler interop (vite/rollup/webpack)" and assigned to @aj and @maria.
